title: About Dzvin.co
intro: Dzvin.co is an evidence-based mental health analytics platform that combines psychometric instruments, behavioral signals, and predictive models for early risk detection and better decision support.
introExtended: The platform works with daily state signals — stress, mood, energy, and focus — as well as psychometric test results to track change over time, identify influencing factors, and build both personal and team-level action scenarios. On this basis, it delivers user recommendations, analytical signals for teams, and a validation loop that checks model quality against real outcomes.

Evolution.title: From observation to prediction
Evolution.description: Most mental health solutions describe only the current state. Dzvin.co moves from observation to prediction, and from prediction to verifiable action.

stepDescriptions.happened: The system captures behavioral signals, rhythm changes, and state dynamics without collapsing everything into a single score.
stepDescriptions.means: Each signal is interpreted in the context of the individual, cohort patterns, and organizational environment.
stepDescriptions.next: The model estimates state trajectories and identifies the scenarios most likely to unfold next.
stepDescriptions.action: The platform compares intervention scenarios and shows which actions can change the expected outcome.
stepDescriptions.evidence: Observed outcomes feed back into the system to test conclusions and improve model reliability.

context.title: A closed loop of analysis, prediction, and verification
context.description: Each stage builds on the previous one: signals gain context, predictions become action, and action becomes validated outcome.

signal.title: Signals
signal.description: Behavioral, psychometric, and contextual data are treated as one system of interconnected factors.

prediction.title: Prediction
prediction.description: The model estimates change dynamics and highlights the scenarios most likely to unfold with or without intervention.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Actual outcomes are fed back into the system to test conclusions and increase model reliability.

business.title: For businesses
business.description: Gives leaders and HR early risk signals, team-level dynamics, and a stronger basis for decisions about wellbeing, productivity, and retention.

user.title: For users
user.description: Helps people notice personal patterns, better understand state changes, and receive recommendations grounded in everyday context.

research.title: For researchers and research institutions
research.description: Provides an environment for working with anonymized behavioral data, testing hypotheses, and evaluating model quality at the population level.

Architecture.title: Platform architecture
Architecture.overviewDescription: The platform is built as an analytical core, a user layer, and a validation layer that operate together as one decision system.
Architecture.overviewDescriptionLead: The analytical core, user layer, and validation layer operate as one decision-support system.
Architecture.overviewDescriptionFollowup: Together they connect user personalization, team-level signals, and scientific verification of model quality.
Architecture.interactionHint: Choose a layer from the chips or click the card on the right to expand its role in more detail.

core.title: Analytical and Prediction Core
core.description: Combines behavioral signals, psychometric results, and predictive logic to estimate state dynamics and risk patterns.

b2c.title: User Layer
b2c.description: Turns complex analytics into understandable state check-ins, personal insights, recommendations, and action scenarios.

loop.title: Outcome Validation System
loop.description: Feeds actual outcomes back into the system, tests prediction quality, and builds trust in the model.

Value.title: Core value
Value.description: The platform’s value is not only in observing mental state, but in turning signals into explainable and verifiable decisions.

points.cohort: Works not only with isolated signals, but with cohort and behavioral patterns.
points.explainable: Provides recommendations with factor-level context rather than as a black box.
points.outcome: Checks what worked in practice and refines models using new outcomes.
